text:
zara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem. We need: final statuspage wording, a brief customer-facing summary, and a clear playbook for sharing RCAs with customers. Legal raised concerns about exposing traces and query text. Assign owners?

ethan: I can take the statuspage short copy. Will post a tidy draft in an hour.

frankie: I'll own the customer summary + outreach email. Thinking: timeline, impact, what we fixed, prevention work, and how customers can request more details.

diana: Ops: recurring symptom here is KV-cache thrash/eviction storms — spotted similar signatures in 5 incidents over the last quarter. Need a remediation ticket with detection rule and an owner. I'll create the ticket.

legal-squad: Legal note: prefer "technical summary" for public posts. Do NOT include raw request contents, hostnames, or unredacted traces. If a customer requests internal logs, require CSM coordination and a signed consent/NDA. We'll provide a redaction checklist.

ops-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.company/pm/INC-2026-900 0assigned to @zara

zara: Thanks. Ethan, paste the status copy here when ready. Frankie, can you target Tue EOD for the customer email template? Diana, please open the remediation ticket today and add ETA.

ethan: Draft status copy below:
```
Status: Partial degradation of generation API.
Impact: increased latency and intermittent errors for a subset of requests between 04:10-04:38 UTC.
Current status: Mitigated after rollback; monitoring is ongoing.
Next steps: A technical summary will be published on the status page and a customer-facing note will be shared by <date>.
```
Thoughts?

frankie: Looks fine. Suggest adding: "Data integrity: no customer data was altered or lost." Also add a contact link for impacted customers. I'll draft the outreach and a minimal consent checkbox:

"I consent to receive a redacted internal report about this incident. I understand that raw logs/traces require a signed consent form/NDA and CSM coordination."

zara: Decision: public technical summary on the status page + offer an expanded internal report to affected enterprise customers on request. Require CSM confirmation + signed consent/NDA before sharing any logs or raw traces. Owners: ethan (status copy), frankie (customer summary & consent language), diana (remediation ticket). Deadlines: status today, customer email Tue EOD, remediation ticket within 48h.

diana: Created INF-5233 "kv-cache eviction: guardrails + alerting" (owner: diana). ETA: 3 weeks. Acceptance criteria: (1) alert when >3 eviction events in 15m, (2) runbook with mitigation steps, (3) automated safeguard reduces eviction frequency under load by >=70%. I'll attach the Grafana rule.

frankie: I'll post the drafted email + short FAQ tomorrow and include the consent checkbox text. Sample FAQ Q: "How can I request more details?" A: "Contact your CSM; they'll coordinate consent and delivery of a redacted technical report"

legal-squad: We'll post the redaction checklist and a short consent template by EOD tomorrow. Quick guidance: remove hostnames, internal timestamps, and any request payloads that could contain customer data.

cs-run: CS will proactively contact top affected customers. I'll create a tracker with owners and dates and share with @frankie and @zara by Wed.

zara: Async review tomorrow 10:30am PT to sign off on drafts. Final action items here:
- Statuspage technical summary (owner: ethan) — draft today
- Customer-facing summary + outreach email + consent checkbox (owner: frankie) — draft Tue EOD
- RCA access playbook & consent template (owner: legal-squad) — template EOD tomorrow
- Remediation ticket + detection rule (owner: diana) — INF-5233 created, ETA 3w
- CS proactive outreach tracker (owner: cs-run) — tracker Wed

ethan: ack :thumbsup:

frankie: ack, will post drafts here.

diana: ack, linking INF-5233 to the postmortem.

zara: Thanks all. I'll update the incident board and move the comms card to In Progress. If Legal posts edits, please respond here so we can iterate before pushing to staging.
